name: codetas
description: Reuse reviewable Hermes project context, skills, and connection metadata inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: CODETAS is a local-first companion that discovers Hermes project instructions and reusable skills, then exposes them to Codex through a reviewable session hook and read-only MCP tools. Source files and credentials are never copied or modified automatically.
defaultPrompt: このプロジェクトでCODETASが再利用できるHermes設定を確認して
HermesのプロジェクトコンテキストとスキルをCodex向けに整理して
